main.description: Cancel a pending ownership transfer without moving ownership. Callable by the current owner (who proposed it) or by the proposed new owner (declining). Clears the pending proposal.

repo.description: The handle or DID of the target group. Omit when supplied via the querystring.

cancelled.description: True — a pending proposal was cleared.

errors.name: UnknownGroup
errors.description: The repo does not resolve to a managed group.

errors.name: NoPendingTransfer
errors.description: There is no live pending transfer to cancel.

errors.name: NotPartyToTransfer
errors.description: The caller is neither the proposing owner nor the proposed new owner.
